short_description: Verify incoming store deliveries against purchase orders, inspect quality, record discrepancies, and release stock.

questions.question: How does the store know a supplier delivery is expected?
options: Delivery calendar / POS purchase order schedule
Email notice forwarded by buyer or owner
Carrier simply turns up at the back door

questions.question: Who checks quantities and items against the purchase order or delivery note?
options: Whoever is nearest the back door when delivery arrives

questions.question: What inspection is performed for damage, expiry, quality or wrong items?
options: No formal check — just sign delivery slip

questions.question: How are discrepancies documented and communicated to the supplier?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Annotated on paper delivery note, photographed, and emailed to supplier or head office...

questions.question: Who labels and decides where stock is stored?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Stockroom assistant prints price tags and puts stock in numbered aisles or available shelf space...

questions.question: When and how is the stock record updated?
options: Scanned directly into POS upon receipt
Entered manually into POS/spreadsheet by manager later that day or week
Stock goes on floor first; paperwork entered later

questions.question: What happens when the delivery is partial, damaged or does not match the order?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Quarantined in backroom while manager chases supplier for credit note...

short_description: Identify empty shelves, locate backroom stock, replenish floor displays, and log out-of-stock issues.

questions.question: How are shelf gaps identified?
How do staff locate the required stock in the backroom?
options: Searching shelves manually or asking supervisor

questions.question: Who decides replenishment priorities during busy periods?
options: Staff pick whatever gap they see first

questions.question: How is shelf quantity or product placement checked after replenishment?
options: Staff self-check FIFO/facing as they restock

questions.question: How are out-of-stock items and unavailable backroom stock recorded?
options: Written on a clipboard or whiteboard

questions.question: Who follows up on repeated stock gaps or supplier delays?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Store manager checks out-of-stock list every Tuesday and emails buyer...

questions.question: What interruptions or duplicate checks slow replenishment?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Staff pulled to tills mid-restock, or searching multiple backroom piles for items showing in POS...

short_description: Close tills, count cash and tender totals, investigate variances, approve adjustments, and file close reports.

questions.question: Who closes each till and at what point in the shift?
options: Cashier closes own till at shift end with supervisor present
Duty manager closes all tills at store closing
Rotating staff close tills without a fixed handover rule

questions.question: What sales, cash, card and other tender records are compared?
Who independently checks the cash count or reconciliation?
options: Second person (supervisor or manager) performs blind count / review
Only checked if the total looks noticeably wrong
Same person who operated till counts and signs off alone

questions.question: What happens when a variance is found?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Recount cash, review voids/refund slips, log variance reason on sheet...

questions.question: Who can approve adjustments, refunds or voids?
options: Manager PIN / sign-off required for all voids and adjustments
Threshold rule — minor variances logged by supervisor, larger by manager
Cashiers can process without prior approval

questions.question: Where are close reports and supporting evidence stored?
options: Digital close record in POS/accounting + scanned slips
Paper binder / safe folder + spreadsheet summary
Receipts kept in envelopes or desk drawer

questions.question: How are unresolved variances tracked until closure?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Tracked on variance log until finance reconciles bank deposit...

short_description: Locate original transactions at counter, apply policy & inspection checks, approve refunds, and route stock.

questions.question: How does the customer present a return and how do staff find the original sale?
options: Receipt barcode scanned / looked up in POS by customer email or card
Manual date/item search in POS when receipt is missing
Paper receipt book or handwritten lookup

questions.question: What policy checks are required before accepting the return?
How is the item's condition assessed and recorded?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Associate visually inspects item at till and selects return reason code in POS...

questions.question: When is manager approval required?
options: No receipt, outside return window, or cash refund above threshold
Manager must approve every return on the till
Staff handle all returns without approval

questions.question: How is the refund or exchange processed and checked?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Refunded to original payment card via POS and signed slip placed in till...

questions.question: How is returned stock routed to resale, repair, supplier return or write-off?
options: Separate labelled bins behind till with reason tags
Left behind counter until manager sorts it at end of day
Put straight back on the shop floor unless visibly broken

questions.question: How are unusual patterns or disputed returns escalated?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Store manager reviews CCTV/receipt history and logs repeated policy exceptions...
